findings.issue: verify(live=True) requires observed_head==current HEAD, so a cache included in a commit can never pass its own later live check even when all captured bytes match. This creates an impossible containing-commit/self-reference demand.
findings.requested_resolution: Keep HEAD frozen during capture/CAS transaction for concurrent-change detection; in later --live verification use exact source/catalog/context byte and identity equality as the source-custody claim. Expose HEAD observation change separately, without source invalidation unless an explicitly HEAD-bound claim is being checked. Add a meaningful test: snapshot, commit the cache without source edits, then --live byte verification passes and head-observation-change is reported.

findings.issue: expand currently drops captured catalog bytes although they are part of immutable snapshot/role evidence.
findings.requested_resolution: Restore captured catalogs too into the empty expansion target (raw sources+catalogs+context), report separate source/catalog/context counts, preserve source-role boundaries. Do not claim this is a complete external dependency reconstruction.
